text:
The clinical presentation of alternating diarrhea and constipation triggered by stress (final exams) is characteristic of Irritable Bowel Syndrome with mixed bowel habits. The sympathetic innervation to the gastrointestinal viscera involved in this condition originates from the thoracic spinal cord segments T5 through L2, which synapse in the prevertebral ganglia before reaching the gut via splanchnic nerves and pelvic splanchnics (though the latter are parasympathetic). Therefore, the sympathetic fibers arise specifically from the lateral horn of the spinal cord between levels T5 and L2.

CONFIDENCE: 95
